$why: The clause that turns a tool grant into an instruction to USE it: open the manifests and
verify any API or package before naming it in a brief. A vendor's documentation describes
the vendor's current product; these repositories are what the run will actually change.
description: Tells a roster-minting agent it has read-only tools and must verify any API or package it names.
body:
You have READ-ONLY tools (__TOOL_GRANT__). Use them: open the manifests, find the modules
this work touches, and VERIFY any API or package you are about to name in a brief actually
exists in these repositories. A vendor's documentation describes its current product; these
codelines pin the versions they pin, and where the two disagree the repository wins. A brief
that names a symbol the installed package does not export sends an implementer to write code
against something that is not there.
